summary: Theorem4.2 and its proof evaluate the activation Jacobian at x instead of Wx. An admissible ReLU counterexample has a surjective LoRA differential despite the printed singularity assumption, invalidating a central nonlinear-expressivity comparison. Corrected theorem proved; linear bound and reported empirical outcomes not refuted. Two local release defects affect the GLUE reproduction protocol and the requested LLaMA checkpointing flag.
limitations: No author code or training executed; no independent GPU memory, timing or accuracy reproduction.
Full later revision/errata search not performed.

problems.title: Nonlinear expressivity theorem uses the wrong Jacobian basepoint
problems.claim_location: PDF p3 Eqs2–3; p6 Theorem4.2 and following dependency; p12 AppendixA.2 Eq19
problems.assumptions: d2,x=(-1,-1),W=-I,f=coordinateReLU. Nonzero state, Jf(x)=0 singular; x andWx away fromkinks. Rank1 paths H=vxT/||x||² allowed.
problems.check: Exact chain rule and local equality F(H)=Hx; independent central differences eps1e-6 in two basis directions. Smooth scalar alternative x1,W2,f(z)=(z−1)^2.
problems.result: Jf(Wx)=I; DF0 reaches allR2, contradicting stated proper-subspace conclusion. Finite error<3e-11.
problems.counterevidence: Corrected singularity condition atWx gives intended true image theorem. Deep-linear theorem valid; empirical scores and memory not contradicted. Factor-initialization tangent is a distinct domain.
problems.impact: Invalid core theoretical derivation used to argue greater nonlinear adaptability; no whole-paper or benchmark collapse claim.
